import json, subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
run = Path('/root/autodl-tmp/liftcut/runs/g3-run-20261003-053547')
ops = Path('/root/autodl-tmp/liftcut/runs/g3-ops-20261003-053547')
def read(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.is_file() else None
def tail(p, n=1):
    return p.read_text().splitlines()[-n:] if p.is_file() else []
processes = []
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdigit():
        continue
    try:
        argv = (p / 'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\x00', b' ').decode()
        if len(argv) < 6000 and ('g3-run-20261003-053547' in argv or 'g3-ops-20261003-053547' in argv):
            processes.append({'pid': int(p.name), 'argv': argv})
    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
        pass
result = {'observed_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'read_only': True,
 'gpu': subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'], text=True, timeout=10).strip(),
 'processes': processes, 'server_events_tail': tail(run / 'events.jsonl', 8),
 'setup_guard': tail(ops / 'setup-guard.jsonl', 2),
 'prelaunch_guard': tail(ops / 'prelaunch-guard.jsonl', 2),
 'deadline_guard': tail(run / 'deadline-guard.jsonl', 2), 'arms': {}}
for arm in ('stop_half', 'stop_all'):
    training = run / 'training' / arm
    result['arms'][arm] = {'last_training_step': tail(training / 'training.jsonl'),
      'control_reproduction': read(training / 'control-reproduction.json'),
      'probe': read(training / 'memory-probe.json'), 'report': read(training / 'report.json'),
      'episodes': {panel: sum(1 for _ in (run / 'evaluation' / arm / panel / 'episodes.jsonl').open())
        if (run / 'evaluation' / arm / panel / 'episodes.jsonl').is_file() else 0
        for panel in ('normal','diagnostic','d2')}}
result['comparison'] = read(run / 'comparison.json')
lease = Path('/root/autodl-tmp/liftcut/ops/overnight-20261003')
result['overnight'] = {name: read(lease / name) for name in ('guard-armed.json','handoff-complete.json')}
result['overnight']['events'] = tail(lease / 'events.jsonl', 10)
result['overnight']['handoff_log'] = tail(lease / 'handoff.log', 30)
result['overnight']['status'] = read(run / 'window-status.json')
result['overnight']['index'] = read(run / 'backup-index.json')
print(json.dumps(result))
